source: Players are real IPL names recalled from memory, not checked against 2026-27 squad or auction records. Current players carry their franchise as of the last recorded season. Retired players carry the franchise they last represented in the IPL; defunct franchises map to their closest current successor. Franchises and roles, including last-franchise assignments, must be verified before release. Category counts follow the approved split (125 marquee, 100 capped, 75 uncapped). Ratings are fantasy estimates from category and role plus a deterministic per-name offset, not career statistics. No troubleRating is set, so every player uses the base value of 2 until the owner adds reviewed entries.
